spoken_summary: An interviewer asks a 21-year-old about their injuries, and the person confirms they will be permanently blind in one eye. They detail their injuries, including a ruptured globe, skull fractures, and having shards of metal, glass, and plastic removed from their eye. They state that the projectile also contained pepper, making it hard to breathe, and that a piece of shrapnel nearly hit their carotid artery, concluding it was a 'miracle' they survived.
